1: // Simple Orbit Escape game
2: // Canvas element with id "game" is expected in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   // Audio context for sound effects
9:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
10:   const playTone = (freq, duration) => {
11:     const oscillator = audioCtx.createOscillator();
12:     const gainNode = audioCtx.createGain();
13:     oscillator.type = 'sine';
14:     oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
15:     gainNode.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
16:     oscillator.connect(gainNode).connect(audioCtx.destination);
17:     oscillator.start();
18:     oscillator.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
19:   };
20: 
21:   // Resize to fill parent
22:   const resize = () => {
23:     canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
24:     canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
25:     // create planet gradient based on new size
26:     planet.gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(
27:       planet.x,
28:       planet.y,
29:       planet.radius * 0.2,
30:       planet.x,
31:       planet.y,
32:       planet.radius
33:     );
34:     planet.gradient.addColorStop(0, '#3aa');
35:     planet.gradient.addColorStop(1, '#113');
36:     // regenerate stars for new canvas size
37:     stars.length = 0;
38:     for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
39:       stars.push({
40:         x: (Math.random() - 0.5) * canvas.width,
41:         y: (Math.random() - 0.5) * canvas.height,
42:         radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
43:       });
44:     }
45:   };
46:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
47:   resize();
48: 
49:   // Planet (center of canvas)
50:   const planet = { x: 0, y: 0, radius: 30, gradient: null };
51:   const stars = [];
52:   const starCount = 100;
53:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
54:     stars.push({
55:       x: (Math.random() - 0.5) * canvas.width,
56:       y: (Math.random() - 0.5) * canvas.height,
57:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
58:     });
59:   }
60: 
61:   // Ship state
62:   const ship = {
63:     x: 0,
64:     y: -200,
65:     vx: 0,
66:     vy: 0,
67:     angle: Math.PI / 2,
68:     radius: 8,
69:     thrust: 0.1,
70:   };
71: 
72:   // Asteroids
73:   const asteroids = [];
74:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 2000; // ms
75:   let lastSpawn = 0;
76: 
77:   // Mouse drag handling for thrust
78:   let dragging = false;
79:   let dragStart = { x: 0, y: 0 };
80:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
81:     // Ensure audio context is resumed on user interaction
82:     if (audioCtx.state !== 'running') audioCtx.resume();
83:     dragging = true;
84:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
85:     dragStart.x = e.clientX - rect.left;
86:     dragStart.y = e.clientY - rect.top;
87:   });
88:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', e => {
89:     if (!dragging) return;
90:     dragging = false;
91:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
92:     const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
93:     const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
94:     const dx = x - dragStart.x;
95:     const dy = y - dragStart.y;
96:     // Apply thrust opposite to drag direction (like pulling back)
97:     ship.vx += -dx * ship.thrust * 0.01;
98:     ship.vy += -dy * ship.thrust * 0.01;
99:     // Play thrust sound
100:     playTone(600, 0.05);
101:   });
102: 
103:   const now = () => performance.now();
104: 
105:   const update = (delta) => {
106:     // Gravity towards planet
107:     const dx = ship.x - planet.x;
108:     const dy = ship.y - planet.y;
109:     const distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
110:     const dist = Math.sqrt(distSq);
111:     const grav = 200 / distSq; // simple gravity constant
112:     ship.vx -= (dx / dist) * grav * (delta / 1000);
113:     ship.vy -= (dy / dist) * grav * (delta / 1000);
114: 
115:     // Update ship position
116:     ship.x += ship.vx * (delta / 1000);
117:     ship.y += ship.vy * (delta / 1000);
118: 
119:     // Spawn asteroids
120:     if (now() - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
121:       lastSpawn = now();
122:       const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
123:       const radius = Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height) / 2 + 50;
124:       const ax = Math.cos(angle) * radius;
125:       const ay = Math.sin(angle) * radius;
126:       const speed = 50 + Math.random() * 50;
127:       const vx = -Math.cos(angle) * speed / 1000;
128:       const vy = -Math.sin(angle) * speed / 1000;
129:       asteroids.push({ x: ax, y: ay, vx, vy, radius: 10 + Math.random() * 10 });
130:     }
131: 
132:     // Update asteroids
133:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
134:       const a = asteroids[i];
135:       a.x += a.vx * delta;
136:       a.y += a.vy * delta;
137:       // Remove if far away
138:       if (Math.abs(a.x) > canvas.width * 2 || Math.abs(a.y) > canvas.height * 2) {
139:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
140:         continue;
141:       }
142:       // Collision with ship
143:       const dxA = a.x - ship.x;
144:       const dyA = a.y - ship.y;
145:       const dA = Math.hypot(dxA, dyA);
146: if (dA < a.radius + ship.radius) {
147:           // Collision sound
148:           playTone(200, 0.3);
149:           alert('Game Over – Collision!');
150:           resetGame();
151:           return;
152:         }
153:     }
154: 
155:     // Lose if too far from planet
156:     if (dist > canvas.width) {
157:       alert('Game Over – Escaped!');
158:       resetGame();
159:     }
160:   };
161: 
162:   const resetGame = () => {
163:     ship.x = 0;
164:     ship.y = -200;
165:     ship.vx = 0;
166:     ship.vy = 0;
167:     asteroids.length = 0;
168:     lastSpawn = now();
169:   };
170: 
171:   const draw = () => {
172:     // Black background
173:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
174:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
175: 
176:     // Stars (drawn in canvas coordinates, no translation)
177:     for (const s of stars) {
178:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
179:       ctx.beginPath();
180:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
181:       ctx.fill();
182:     }
183: 
184:     // Translate to center for game objects
185:     ctx.save();
186:     ctx.translate(canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
187: 
188:     // Planet with gradient
189:     ctx.fillStyle = planet.gradient || '#2b2b2b';
190:     ctx.beginPath();
191:     ctx.arc(planet.x, planet.y, planet.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
192:     ctx.fill();
193: 
194:     // Ship as triangle pointing direction of velocity
195:     const shipAngle = Math.atan2(ship.vy, ship.vx) || -Math.PI / 2;
196:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
197:     ctx.beginPath();
198:     ctx.moveTo(
199:       ship.x + Math.cos(shipAngle) * ship.radius * 2,
200:       ship.y + Math.sin(shipAngle) * ship.radius * 2
201:     );
202:     ctx.lineTo(
203:       ship.x + Math.cos(shipAngle + Math.PI * 0.8) * ship.radius,
204:       ship.y + Math.sin(shipAngle + Math.PI * 0.8) * ship.radius
205:     );
206:     ctx.lineTo(
207:       ship.x + Math.cos(shipAngle - Math.PI * 0.8) * ship.radius,
208:       ship.y + Math.sin(shipAngle - Math.PI * 0.8) * ship.radius
209:     );
210:     ctx.closePath();
211:     ctx.fill();
212: 
213:     // Asteroids with simple gray gradient
214:     for (const a of asteroids) {
215:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.radius * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.radius);
216:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#bbb');
217:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
218:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
219:       ctx.beginPath();
220:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
221:       ctx.fill();
222:     }
223: 
224:     ctx.restore();
225:   };
226: 
227:   let lastTime = now();
228:   const loop = () => {
229:     const nowTime = now();
230:     const delta = nowTime - lastTime;
231:     lastTime = nowTime;
232:     update(delta);
233:     draw();
234:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
235:   };
236:   loop();
237: })();

(End of file - total 237 lines)
</content>
